name: tun-current
description: Starter TUN Blueprint representing the category structure from the developer specification (#22). Channel names inside each category are PLACEHOLDERS - edit this file (or better, run /tun blueprint save on the real, already-configured TUN server) before treating this as the source of truth. This file is data, not code: the bot never hardcodes this structure.
howToUse: Recommended: on the real TUN server, run `/tun blueprint save name:tun-current` to capture the ACTUAL live structure instead of using this placeholder file.
Alternative: edit the channel names below to match reality, then run `/tun blueprint import` with this file attached, name:tun-current.
Either way, review with `/tun blueprint view name:tun-current` before ever restoring it onto a server.
